caption: I made mini pumpkin pies for 12 months old baby, with zero added sugar and no flour, so gluten-free, and Zenith just devoured them. 1. Mash 3 ripe bananas  2. Add 1 cup of pumpkin purée, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup of milk and a teaspoon of vanilla extract (optional) 3. Mix them well, and ur pumpkin pie filling is done! 👌🏼 4. Make the easiest pie crust by blending 1.5 cups of oats and 6 tablespoon of butter — blend until u get fine crumbs 5. Spread & press oats crust into molds, fill up with fillings  6. Bake at 370F for 40-50 min 7. Cool off for 20 min, chill in fridge for another 30 min to settle then serve! Zenith enjoyed this healthy snack so much that she literally licked crumbs off her plate after devouring two pies straight 😋😂 . . . . #BLW#babyledweaning#blwrecipes#blwideas#babymeals#toddlermeals#toddlersnacks#babyfood#cooking#cookwithme#healthyrecipe#glutenfreedessert#flourless#glutenfree#dessert#pumpkinpie
